# ✅ Completed Application Features & Changelog

Here is the tracking sheet of implemented administrative features and system updates for the Field Force Management System.

---

### 🔑 Authentication & Profiles
*   [x] **Offline Login Mode** — Enabled local offline session storage when backend servers are unreachable.
*   [x] **Auto-Generated Passwords** — Implemented an 8-12 character auto-password generator & regeneration action in user details editing page.
*   [x] **Dynamic Admin Profile Drawer** — Includes First Name, Last Name, Designation, Photo Upload, Email, and Mobile No. fields.
*   [x] **Change Password Flow** — Secure password resets for all accounts.

### ✉️ Dispatch Notifications
*   [x] **Late Arrival Alert Dispatches** — Send warnings for tardiness to the Admin with manual and automatic buttons.
*   [x] **New Task Assigned Emails** — Instant mail dispatch triggers with checkboxes and success toast confirmations.
*   [x] **Device Switched Off Warnings** — Auto-dispatches email/alerts to the admin if an employee's phone remains inactive for >30 minutes (includes last reported battery % and GPS coordinates).

### 📈 Metrics & Advanced Insights
*   [x] **Overview Insights** — Includes allocation breakup meters, live activity feeds, geofence breaches, active coverage maps, and monthly budget burn meters.
*   [x] **Attendance Analytics** — Includes interactive compliance heatmaps, punctuality scoreboard rankings, and average delay meters.
*   [x] **Expense Audits** — Includes visual spending categories breakdown, billing compliance flags, and budget warning badges.

### 💼 Field Activities
*   [x] **Visits (Demo)** — Active filters, executive drop-down selectors, and booking scheduler modal.
*   [x] **Visit Beat Plans** — Daily timelines, sequence maps, km counters, and routing optimization tools.
*   [x] **Customers** — Contact directory tables, POC list, coordinate inputs, categories, and CSV directory exporter.

### 📊 Performance Reports
*   [x] **Travel Expenses** — Monthly summaries, per-employee breakdowns, interactive category charts, and CSV exporting.
*   [x] **Productivity Reports** — Per-employee task throughput scorecard, KPI bars, and trend indicators.
*   [x] **Compliance Metrics** — Tri-dimensional scores, color-coded status levels, and critical alert banners.

### 📝 Form Managers & Global Settings
*   [x] **Forms** — Leave Applications manager and Anonymous Feedback submission systems.
*   [x] **User Management** — Multi-role query filters, search bars, and quick actions.
*   [x] **Territory Setup** — Interactive region cards with executive and site counters.
*   [x] **Travel Policies** — Configurable mileage, per diem, and lodging allowance parameters.
*   [x] **Security & Access** — Multi-factor auth, device, and network whitelisting panels.
